summary.text: Danielle Bell is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 44 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Don Parsons (R).
A licensed clinical social worker and business and executive coach, she says her priorities include lowering the cost of living and health care access.

paragraphs.text: Danielle Bell was born in Batesville, Indiana.
She earned a bachelor's degree from DePauw University in 2007 and a degree from Case Western Reserve University in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a licensed clinical social worker and as a certified business and executive coach.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Bell said she grew up on a family farm, chose a career in healthcare and mental health, and moved to Georgia in 2015 with her husband, a Navy chief, where they are raising three daughters.
She said her campaign focuses on reducing the cost of living, including electricity costs, and on healthcare equality.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
